text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, Corvale General holds 326 vials of caspofungin acetate 7 mg/mL, 10.8 mL, providing 20.2 days on hand at current use. Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC posted a discontinuation with initial posting date 2026-01-12. Jiangsu Hengrui Pharmaceuticals Co. (US Agent eVenus Pharmaceutical Laboratories, Inc.) posted a discontinuation with initial posting date 2026-06-30.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list shows caspofungin acetate is not listed as of 2026-10-21. FDA status is To Be Discontinued since an unspecified date.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately three weeks. Multiple manufacturers not on the FDA shortage list have available product. No FDA shortage listing exists to trigger allocation or emergency measures.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to execute purchase from Fosun Pharma USA Inc., the top-ranked option, pending P&T committee approval of the vendor change.
2. Buyer to qualify Gland Pharma Limited as a secondary source, pending P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer to qualify Merck Sharp & Dohme LLC as a tertiary source, pending P&T committee approval.
4. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list weekly and report any status change to P&T committee chair.

Not recommended: Delaying procurement until inventory falls below 14 days on hand. Switching to alternative antifungal agents without clinical review by the treating clinicians and the committee.
